Q: 破魔树根有什么用？在哪里找？
Q: What are Lightroots for, and where do I find them?
破魔树根是地底世界的传送点，激活后可以照亮周围区域并作为快速旅行点。全地图共有120个破魔树根，与地上神庙位置相对应（正下方）。建议先激活地上神庙，然后从神庙位置向下跳入地底寻找对应的破魔树根。查看完整地图：破魔树根位置

Lightroots are warp points in the Depths. Once activated, they light up the surrounding area and serve as fast-travel points. There are 120 Lightroots across the whole map, each corresponding to a surface Shrine (directly below it). We recommend activating a surface Shrine first, then jumping down from the Shrine's location into the Depths to find the matching Lightroot. See the full map: Lightroot Locations

Q: 主线任务建议按什么顺序完成？
Q: What order is recommended for completing the main quests?
推荐顺序：风→水→火→雷 • 风之神殿（利特村）：最简单，丘栗风力能力实用 • 水之神殿（卓拉之里）：希多水球盾强力防御 • 火之神殿（格鲁德沙漠）：阿沅翻滚破岩方便 • 雷之神殿（格鲁德高地）：难度最高，放最后 查看详细主线流程：主线任务攻略

Recommended order: Wind → Water → Fire → Lightning • Wind Temple (Rito Village): the easiest; Tulin's wind ability is very useful • Water Temple (Zora's Domain): Sidon's water bubble shield is a powerful defense • Fire Temple (Gerudo Desert): Yunobo's rolling ability makes breaking rocks easy • Lightning Temple (Gerudo Highlands): the hardest, so save it for last See the detailed main quest walkthrough: Main Quest Guide
Q: 瘴气之心（黑色心形）如何恢复？
Q: How do I restore Gloom Hearts (the black hearts)?
地底瘴气造成的损伤（黑色心形）需要使用太阳花料理或阳光花料理恢复。推荐配方： • 野菜牛奶粥（太阳花+鲜奶+岩盐）：完全恢复瘴气心 • 蒸太阳花（仅太阳花）：简单快速 太阳花可在地上世界采集，也可在地底商店购买。查看完整料理配方：料理合成攻略

Damage from Gloom in the Depths (the black hearts) must be restored with Sundelion dishes or Sunshine-Flower dishes. Recommended recipes: • Sunny Veggie Porridge (Sundelion + Fresh Milk + Rock Salt): fully restores Gloom Hearts • Steamed Sundelion (Sundelion only): simple and quick Sundelions can be gathered in the surface world or bought in Depths shops. See all cooking recipes: Cooking Guide

Q: 大师剑在哪里获取？需要什么条件？
Q: Where do I get the Master Sword, and what are the requirements?
大师剑位于龙泪湖上空，由白龙（塞尔达）守护。获取条件： • 至少2格精力（需要40点祝福之光） • 建议先完成4个神殿任务，获得贤者誓约 • 骑乘龙背拔出大师剑（需等待白龙从地底飞出） 提示：大师剑攻击力30，融合后可达50+，且可自动修复。查看详细获取方法：哈里的武器秘籍

The Master Sword is located in the sky above Dracozu Lake, guarded by the Light Dragon (Zelda). Requirements: • At least 2 full Stamina Wheels (requiring 40 Lights of Blessing) • We recommend completing the 4 temple quests first to obtain the Sages' Vows • Ride on the dragon's back to pull out the Master Sword (you'll need to wait for the Light Dragon to fly up from the Depths) Tip: The Master Sword has 30 attack power, can reach 50+ after fusing, and repairs itself automatically. See how to get it in detail: Harry's Weapon Secrets

Q: 如何快速升级套装？需要什么材料？
Q: How do I upgrade armor sets quickly, and what materials do I need?
套装升级需要找到大妖精并提供升级材料。升级步骤： 1. 完成乐团任务解锁4个大妖精 2. 收集对应套装的升级材料（怪物掉落、矿石、植物） 3. 前往大妖精处升级（每个大妖精负责不同等级） 推荐优先升级：蛮族套装（攻击+）、古代英杰套装（箭矢消耗-）、攀爬套装（雨天攀爬） 查看详细升级材料：套装获取攻略

Upgrading an armor set requires finding a Great Fairy and providing upgrade materials. Upgrade steps: 1. Complete the Stable Trotters quests to unlock all 4 Great Fairies 2. Collect the upgrade materials for the set (monster drops, ores, plants) 3. Visit a Great Fairy to upgrade (each Great Fairy handles different upgrade levels) Recommended priority upgrades: Barbarian Set (attack +), Ancient Hero's Aspect (reduced arrow consumption), Climbing Set (climbing in the rain) See detailed upgrade materials: Armor Set Guide

Q: What dishes can instantly restore all my health?
带"生命"前缀的食材，哪怕只放一个，也能触发"完全恢复"效果。推荐配方： • 蒸生命萝卜（1个生命萝卜）：瞬间满血+4颗额外心 • 烤生命大萝卜（1个生命大萝卜）：瞬间满血+5颗额外心 • 蒸生命苹果（1个生命苹果）：瞬间满血+3颗额外心 采集地点：生命萝卜可在卡卡利科村周边采集。查看完整料理配方：料理合成攻略

Q: 呀哈哈种子有什么用？一共多少个？
Q: What are Korok Seeds for, and how many are there in total?
呀哈哈种子用于扩展武器、弓箭、盾牌的持有数量。全地图共有900个呀哈哈种子，但扩展全部格子只需441个。 兑换地点：找森林中的呀哈哈（海布拉地区、林克庄园等） 兑换价格：初期1个种子，后期逐渐增加到5-10个 建议：优先扩展武器和弓箭格子，盾牌格子可后期扩展。

Korok Seeds are used to expand how many weapons, bows, and shields you can carry. There are 900 Korok Seeds across the whole map, but you only need 441 of them to expand every slot. Exchange location: Find Koroks in forests (Hebra region, Link's Manor, etc.) Exchange cost: 1 Seed at first, gradually rising to 5–10 Seeds later Suggestion: expand weapon and bow slots first; shield slots can wait until later.

Q: 如何打败白鬃人马（银色人马）？
Q: How do I defeat a White-Maned Lynel (Silver Lynel)?
白鬃人马是游戏中最强的普通敌人之一。攻略技巧： 1. 装备准备：蛮族套装（二星以上）+大剑香蕉×5料理（3级攻击） 2. 武器选择：七宝匕首融合白银人马角（攻击力200+） 3. 战斗技巧：利用完美闪避触发"极限闪避"，然后连砍5-8次 4. 注意事项：保持距离，避免被火焰箭秒杀 查看详细Boss攻略：白鬃人马攻略

The White-Maned Lynel is one of the strongest regular enemies in the game. Tips: 1. Gear prep: Barbarian Set (2 stars or higher) + a dish made with Mighty Bananas ×5 (Level 3 attack) 2. Weapon choice: Scimitar of the Seven fused with a Silver Lynel Horn (200+ attack) 3. Combat technique: use a perfect dodge to trigger a Flurry Rush, then slash 5–8 times in a row 4. Cautions: keep your distance and avoid being one-shot by fire arrows See the detailed boss guide: White-Maned Lynel Guide

Q: 什么是"弹反"？如何练习？
Q: What is a "parry," and how do I practice it?
弹反（完美格挡）是在敌人攻击即将命中时，按下A键举盾，成功后可弹开敌人攻击并眩晕敌人。 练习方法： 1. 找到波克布林等弱小敌人练习 2. 观察敌人挥剑动作，在武器即将命中时按A 3. 成功后会出现"铛"的金属声和慢动作特效 4. 高级技巧：对守护者激光弹反（需要精确时机） 建议：先从简单敌人开始，熟练后再挑战守护者和Boss。

A parry (perfect guard) is raising your shield with the A button just as an enemy's attack is about to hit; if successful, it deflects the enemy's attack and stuns them. How to practice: 1. Practice on weak enemies like Bokoblins 2. Watch the enemy's sword swing, and press A just as the weapon is about to hit 3. On success you'll hear a metallic "clang" and see a slow-motion effect 4. Advanced technique: parrying Guardian lasers (requires precise timing) Suggestion: start with easy enemies, and only take on Guardians and bosses once you're confident.
